name: JANE — Slow Tide (Harmonic Cut)
notes: Slow Tide — harmonic cut. One continuous breath instead of hits: single analogous palette (indigo→violet→rose→gold→ice), every layer crossfades on the same phrase boundaries (downbeat-locked grid), energy swells follow the per-bar percussive map (blooms at 34.4/51.8/104.2/123.8 are brightness arcs + color warming, not flashes). Pre-drop dips are keyframed fades, no override blackouts. Motion is phrase-rate: 4-bar angle sway, 2-bar swells, 4-bar accelerando sweeps. Wings walk softly (high gate, low bg), all audio_mod inertia-smoothed. No strobes anywhere, gentle 1/2 gates only on steel/accents with high floors.
